method: Native FLINT fractions in Q(x,y,z,p), Z²=f=(H+Cp)²−4p⁶. Differentiates the complete actual rational current before compact reduction. All Z poles, endpoint rows and fiber cochains are retained.
general_current: J=sum_ij q2_ij(x,y,z,p) dx_i wedge dx_j wedge dp/Z+q3(x,y,z,p)dx wedge dy wedge dz/Z. Any higher odd Z pole is included by absorbing powers of f into the rational q coefficients.
WHOLE_exact_zero_test: E=f*(d_base q2−partial_p q3)−(H+Cp)*[q2 wedge(dH+p dC)] +q3*[C(H+Cp)−12p⁵]+y³(H+Cp)/6. Then dJ−beta_original=E*dxdy dz dp/Z³. A genuine candidate passes exactly when the numerator of E is the zero polynomial.
API: build() gives all actual original-field components; audit_form(data,q2,q3) returns the exact rational obstruction. Add the fourth source-bound current to q2,q3 and require not bool(E).
